recommendation.name: Directional min-max using the fixed 27-region 2023 cohort
rationale: All 18 series vary, contain 27 valid observations and have positive SD/IQR. Central IQRs remain visible rather than collapsing to a few points.
Preserve all audited magnitude differences with one affine, direction-aware transformation per indicator.
Z-score and median/IQR retain exactly the same ordering and distribution shape but lack natural 0–100 endpoints; min-max rescaling of either is identical to ordinary min-max.
Percentile midranks erase raw gap magnitudes; winsorization introduces artificial tail ties without evidence that the audited extremes are invalid.
Material endpoint sensitivity is disclosed, especially UHH and Puskesmas. Fixed inputs/anchors provide reproducibility, not uncertainty elimination or a claim of universal robustness.

contract.comparisonCohort: Exactly the frozen 27 Jawa Barat kabupaten/kota and 2023-compatible observations; no region/indicator/year substitution
contract.endpointInterpretation: 0 is the lower-pressure observed endpoint and 100 the higher-pressure observed endpoint of this indicator in this cohort; neither means no real-world pressure or a global maximum
contract.outlierPolicy: Retain every observation. Tukey fences and anchor-deletion diagnostics are flags, not data-error proofs. No selected winsorization, clipping, log transform or value deletion.
contract.missingPolicy: Stop the entire run on missing/non-numeric/non-finite values or incomplete cohort; no zero-fill, interpolation, per-region omission or implicit reweighting
contract.constantPolicy: If min=max, stop with CONSTANT_SERIES. Do not assign 0, 50 or an artificial denominator; require explicit methodology review before a new contract
contract.expectedBoundsPolicy: Reject values outside each documented physical/publisher bound before normalization. Do not confuse cohort extrema with physical limits; do not invent an upper bound for nonnegative years, rates, expenditure or IRBI
contract.outsideCalibrationPolicy: Stop if any value is outside locked calibration extrema; never silently extrapolate or clip to 0/100. A corrected observation or different cohort/year requires an explicit versioned design and input review
contract.robustAlternativeDegeneracy: The current 18 have positive IQR and Q95-Q05. If a future comparison has zero robust scale, this analyzer stops rather than manufacturing candidate values; ordinary min-max itself requires only a positive range
contract.precisionPolicy: Use full stored precision; do not round raw values or normalized values before later weighting. Display rounding must not feed computation
contract.sourceCompositePolicy: Treat overall IRBI and district IKLH as published raw observations; no decomposition, reconstruction or population division
contract.weightingConstraint: Indicator count must not silently determine dimension importance. A singleton must receive neither an automatic premium nor penalty. Choose dimension and any subdimension budgets explicitly and assess overlap/sensitivity in the next stage; no final weights are assigned here.

statisticalConventions.weighting: Unweighted regional distribution diagnostics only, not dimension/indicator aggregation weights
statisticalConventions.quantiles: Type 7 linear interpolation: sorted[(n-1)*p] with linear fractional position
statisticalConventions.zScoreSd: Population SD with divisor n=27, the complete comparison cohort
statisticalConventions.additionalSd: Sample SD with divisor n-1 also reported
statisticalConventions.skewness: Adjusted Fisher-Pearson coefficient sqrt(n*(n-1))/(n-2) times the population third standardized moment
statisticalConventions.outliers: Strictly outside Q1-1.5*IQR or Q3+1.5*IQR; severe diagnostic uses multiplier 3
statisticalConventions.percentile: Average ranks for exact raw-value ties; tied extrema need not attain 0 or 100

attentionPolicy.interpretation: Disclosure heuristics only, not admission, error, deletion or clipping thresholds. Report continuous diagnostics for every indicator.

methods.name: Directional population-SD z-score
methods.formula: sign*(x-mean)/populationSD, where sign=+1 for higher raw pressure, otherwise -1

methods.name: Directional endpoint-scaled percentile midrank
methods.formula: higher-pressure: 100*(r-1)/(n-1); lower-pressure: 100*(n-r)/(n-1); r=one-based average raw-value rank
